about: Small text parts inserted into the prompt templates. See shared/SPEC.md section 6.4.
uiLanguage: German (Swiss spelling: write ss instead of ß)

strengthRules.light: - Be conservative: only fix clear typos and spelling. Leave grammar, punctuation and style as they are.
strengthRules.normal: - Fix spelling, grammar and punctuation, but keep everything else as typed.
strengthRules.strong: - You may also smooth clumsy grammar and sentence structure slightly, but the wording must stay recognisably the user's own.
